what: Inputs for /buyers/act-388-changes/ (batch 2026-11-e, page 5). Every value is a VERIFIED or CORRECTED row of Blog-Brain batches/2026-11-e/facts.md at the verifier's value. The spec computes every bill, share and difference from these inputs and checks them against the ledger.

example.note: A constructed example, not a real parcel: the house was on the roll at $200,000 at one reassessment; the 15% limit lets the next one raise it to $230,000 at most; it sells for $350,000, the same price as page 4's example.
